scoring_note: Equal diagnostic weight across nine MANUAL-V1 tasks (0-100); standalone single public run, no statistical calibration. Quality score is NOT production safety probability. Formal status PASS WITH WARNINGS until repeated, blinded, provider-attested runs are available.
coverage_note: Both new submissions cover 9/9 tasks. The earlier Baidu/Iceman/LongCat reports retain previously reviewed scores; earlier incomplete scores are means over assessed tasks only.
review_method: GitHub connector inspected file scopes, metadata and source. For T02/T03/T04/T05/T08 the tested local source files were verified byte-identical by Git blob SHA to GitHub, then externally graded with Python 3.13 and Node 22. Review/T01/T06/T09 were checked statically. No Docker image/cloud/mobile-device/browser evaluated.
hardware_note: Independent test host is Linux with Python 3.13 and Node 22. Candidate Windows runs used OpenCode 2.2.7. OS-specific path behavior is reported separately.

hy4.shipping: Against buggy function 3 pass/4 fail; against correct reference 7 pass/0 fail

hy4.decision: Proper BLOCKED dispositions and explicit key-overlap safety caveats
hy4.metric_quality: Candidate T07/T08 durations share same timestamps; therefore those per-task timings are not independently measured

tidepool.sync: 10/12 additional sync checks; upsert without optional value adds property value:undefined and server record missing deleted field not rejected
tidepool.filesystem: 16/17 Linux checks, including both symlink cases; rejects valid POSIX name a:b.txt
tidepool.shipping: Against buggy function 1 pass/4 fail; against correct reference 5 pass/0 fail
tidepool.devops: Least-privilege contract violated by permissions:read-all; no setup-node step for Node22. actions/checkout SHA is confirmed to be official v4 ref. No Docker build/CI run

tidepool.decision: Incorrect PARTIAL label for unverified session preservation; old signing key reinstatement needs compromise-aware authorization and security review
tidepool.metric_quality: Only 328 seconds of task intervals documented out of 2,489 seconds total. Unattributed time is not interpreted as model reasoning or waiting
